By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production. The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don't. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation. Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS. Global team, diverse perspectives We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started. Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure. About The Role Throughput. Latency. KV cache utilization. Move those three numbers in the right direction, and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every kernel you tune, every quantization scheme you ship, every scheduler tweak you land shows up directly in a customer's p99 and on our P&L. This is a high-impact seat. It is also a high-autonomy seat as you'll be given the room to lead the technical direction of inference optimization at Kimchi, not execute someone else's roadmap. The problem: running LLMs in production is a moving target. The "right" model and serving configuration for a workload depend on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, quantization tolerance, and a dozen other variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a model once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. Kimchi is the system that makes that decision automatically - continuously matching workloads to the most cost-efficient, best-performing LLM and serving configuration on a customer's infrastructure. We're building the optimization layer between the model and the hardware, and we need engineers who understand both sides deeply. Stack Python; vLLM; SGLang; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; gRP; ClickHouse; PostgreSQL; GCP Pub/Sub; AWS / GCP / Azure; GitLab CI; ArgoCD; Prometheus; Grafana; Loki; Tempo. Requirements: 5+ years building real ML systems, with a portfolio that shows depth in inference or training infrastructure (not just model training notebooks). Strong Python - production services, not scripts. Hands-on experience with at least one of vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM, and a working mental model of why an inference engine performs the way it does on a given GPU. Fluency with quantization tradeoffs - you've measured quality regressions, not just compression ratios. Comfort with distributed systems: collective communication, sharding strategies, and the practical failure modes of multi-GPU and multi-node setups. A bias toward measurement. You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell the difference between a real win and a benchmark artifact. Self-direction. This role comes with a wide mandate; you should be excited by that, not unsettled by it. Responsibilities: Push throughput. Continuous batching, speculative decoding, chunked prefill, kernel-level tuning across vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it. Cut latency. Attack TTFT and TPOT separately. Profile, identify the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, networking), and fix it - not the bottleneck you assumed. Get more out of the KV cache. Paged attention, prefix caching, eviction policies, cache reuse across requests, quantized KV. This is where a lot of the unrealized throughput lives, and it's an area you'll own. Quantize without regressing quality. INT8, INT4, FP8 across weights, activations, and KV. Empirical work: measure quality on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks. Shrink cold starts and memory footprint. Faster init, smarter weight loading, tighter memory accounting - the difference between a model that scales and one that doesn't. Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck on storage or interconnect. Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible experiments. What's in it for you? R4 was founded by Rheinmetall, a leading international systems supplier in the defence industry, and 4iG, Hungary’s leading integrated service provider in telecommunications, systems integration, space and defence industry. Besides delivering high-impact IT projects and services to Rheinmetall’s subsidiaries worldwide, 2026 marks an exciting new chapter, as we extend our reach beyond the global Rheinmetall IT organisation and enter the broader market, offering our expertise to external customers as well. Headquartered in Budapest, we combine the stability of a large international enterprise with the agility of a delivery-focused organisation. Built on strong foundations and guided by clear strategic goals, we are continuously expanding our service portfolio. Backed by two major industry groups and shaped by an international outlook, we offer an inspiring work environment with challenging assignments, international collaboration, and long-term career opportunities for talented professionals. In order to achieve our common goals, we count on you Infrastructure & Service Management: Plan, direct and oversee the operation, design, delivery and further development of IT infrastructure systems, core services (networks, servers, cloud platforms, databases, storage), Service Desk and Process and Request Operations. Operations & Application Supervision: Oversee the full execution of tasks related to core services, infrastructure, application operations and SAP systems, ensuring that IT architecture and technological solutions continuously meet business requirements. Strategic Alignment & Business Growth: Develop strategic directions for your areas, align them with corporate and IT strategies and create/develop services specifically designed to maximize the Company’s business effectiveness. Security & Service Excellence: Take strategic responsibility for IT security operations and compliance with related standards, while ensuring the stability, security, scalability and premium customer service quality of all individual services. Process & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Supervise and support process managers to guarantee efficient workflows and foster tight collaboration with cross-functional teams (IT experts, business analysts, service architects) to ensure seamless integration across systems. Leadership, Culture & Performance: Secure the necessary workforce to build a strong department, manage team performance through clear expectations and regular evaluations and provide professional leadership, mentoring and growth opportunities. Innovation & Trend Monitoring: Continuously monitor industry trends to identify growth opportunities and actively foster a culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement across the organization. What you will need for successful work Successfully completed university studies in (business) informatics, engineering, or a comparable degree More than 10 years of professional experience in IT infrastructure, application management, or comparable senior IT leadership roles Deep, comprehensive knowledge of managing large-scale infrastructure systems (servers, networks, cloud), Service Desk environments and SAP/application operations Strong understanding of IT security operations, risk management and compliance standards Proven track record in professional leadership, mentoring and building high-performing, cross-functional teams Strategic mindset with excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills High degree of initiative, results-orientation and a proactive approach to driving organizational culture (collaboration, innovation) Good proficiency in English and Hungarian (business level), both written and spoken What we offer Take over an important and challenging role with high visibility Become part of the unique growth stories of Rheinmetall and 4iG, which offer outstanding development and career opportunities Gain insight into the defense and automotive industry Make use of the broad network with over 40.000 great colleagues at Rheinmetall and 4iG worldwide Benefit from various professional training and events Enjoy our international and flexible work environment with an official office in Budapest but up to 100% mobile work What we are happy about Deep understanding of international enterprise structures or Shared Service Center (SSC) operations German language skills are a distinct advantage

review_candidates.title: Telematics / Connectivity — Senior Engineer
review_candidates.description: We are seeking an experienced Telematics Senior Engineer / System Specialist / Architect to lead customer-facing engineering activities for telematics and connectivity systems at an automotive OEM. The role covers TCU integration, vehicle-to-cloud connectivity, cellular communication, GNSS, V2X, and related vehicle communication technologies, acting as the primary bridge between the client’s engineering organization and global development teams. Language : Business/Native-level local language (N2 and above) and Business-level English Location : Yokohama Key Responsibilities Act as the primary technical interface between the OEM and global engineering teams Lead TCU system integration, vehicle testing, and field validation Define and review telematics system requirements, architecture, and connected-vehicle standards Support 4G/5G, GNSS, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, V2X functions, and analyze vehicle-to-cloud communication issues Troubleshoot CAN/CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, and diagnostic protocols (UDS/DoIP) Coordinate root-cause analysis, support cybersecurity requirements, and manage technical issues with global teams Participate in OEM design reviews and prepare technical documentation and reports in required languages Required Skills Strong experience in automotive telematics and Telematics Control Unit (TCU) systems Embedded C/C++ and/or Embedded Linux development 4G/5G, TCP/IP, GNSS, and cellular connectivity technologies CAN/CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, UDS, and DoIP diagnostic protocols Vehicle integration, log analysis, and system-level troubleshooting Good to Have Prior experience working directly with automotive OEMs Knowledge of V2X communication technologies and automotive cybersecurity standards Roles & Responsibilities Under direct supervision, works on the architecture and applied knowledge of coding an electronic microcontroller or components and ensure product works to specification. Assists in coding, testing, and debugging software or making enhancements to existing software . Writes programs according to specifications from higher level staff or Technical team.
